evidence.reason: The fresh-snapshot test still writes the backlog with age=3599, only one second below BACKLOG_MAX_AGE_SECONDS. Because the snapshot timestamp is truncated to whole seconds and hold_backfill_groups recomputes the age from a later clock read, the discarded fraction plus elapsed time can make the snapshot exceed 3600 seconds. The test then intermittently holds backfill groups and fails its expected four kept groups. Using a much smaller age changes no intended behavior and removes the timing race. The finding’s cited interval is stale; the offending line is now 295.
